question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

NEGLECT
solution:
The correct answer is '**care**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **antonym **of the given word '**Neglect**' is '**care**'.
 
• **Neglect**: to give too little or no attention or care to somebody/something. [किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु की उपेक्षा करना (बहुत कम ध्यान देना, बिलकुल ध्यान न देना या ख़याल न रखना)]
 
 
• *Example: Don’t **neglect** your health.*
 
 
 
• **Care**: looking after somebody/something so that he/she/it has what he/she/it needs for his/her/its health and protection. (किसी की देखभाल या देखरेख करना)
 
 
• *Example: All the children in their **care** were healthy and happy.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:**__ *Care.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Taste**: the particular quality of different foods or drinks that allows you to recognize them when you put them in your mouth; flavour. (अलग-अलग खाद्यों या पेयों का अपना-अपना स्‍वाद; ज़ायक़ा)
 
• **Wish**: to want something that cannot now happen or that probably will not happen. [(प्रायः भूतकालिक क्रिया के साथ) किसी वस्‍तु की चाह रखना, किसी वस्‍तु को चाहना (ऐसी इच्‍छा रखना जो न अब पूरी हो सकती है और संभवतः न भविष्‍य में)]
 
• **Mock**: to laugh at somebody/something in an unkind way or to make other people laugh at him/her/it. (किसी की हँसी उड़वाना, परिहास का पात्र बनाना या बनवाना)
